description: This file implements an HTTP handler for OpenAI-compatible embedding requests, including input validation, provider selection, and response formatting.

methods.name: coerceRequest
methods.description: Converts an unknown value to an EmbeddingsRequest object if possible.

methods.name: resolveInputTexts
methods.description: Resolves the input payload into an array of strings or null.

methods.name: encodeEmbeddingBase64
methods.description: Encodes a numeric embedding array into a base64 string.

methods.name: validateInputTexts
methods.description: Validates the input texts against maximum count and length constraints.

methods.name: formatErrorMessage
methods.description: Formats an error object into a string message.

methods.name: resolveAutoExplicitProviders
methods.description: Returns a set of provider IDs that are allowed for auto selection.

methods.name: shouldContinueAutoSelection
methods.description: Determines if auto selection should continue after an error for a given provider adapter.

methods.name: createConfiguredEmbeddingProvider
methods.description: Creates a memory embedding provider based on configuration, provider ID, and optional memory search settings.

methods.name: resolveEmbeddingsTarget
methods.description: Resolves the provider and model from a request model string, considering auto and explicit providers.

methods.name: handleOpenAiEmbeddingsHttpRequest
methods.description: Handles an HTTP request for OpenAI-compatible embeddings, including validation, provider selection, and response.
